title: 02 Commercial Power of Attorney & Comparison - Topic Quiz

questions.text: Which transactions does a Commercial Power of Attorney (sections 54-58 UGB) generally cover?
options: All ordinary and extraordinary transactions of any business
Only real estate sales and corporate restructurings
Exclusively ordinary transactions of a specific business
Only representing the company in court proceedings
questions.correctAnswer: Exclusively ordinary transactions of a specific business

questions.text: Massimo Blardone orders coffee beans four times for his cafe without asking, and his boss pays every invoice. How was his Commercial Power of Attorney granted?
options: By implied conduct
By entry in the Commercial Register
By a court decision
By Mixed Prokura

questions.text: Which two actions are allowed for a Prokurist but legally forbidden for a holder of a Commercial Power of Attorney?
options: Buying merchandise and paying salaries
Taking out loans and representing the company in court
Advising customers and agreeing on delivery dates
Selling goods and checking supplier invoices
questions.correctAnswer: Taking out loans and representing the company in court

questions.text: Ricarda Egger manages a C&A branch and may carry out all ordinary transactions of the branch. Which type of authority and signature prefix apply?
options: Special Power of Attorney with the prefix i. A.
Category Power of Attorney with the prefix pp.
Branch Prokura with the prefix i. V.
General Power of Attorney with the prefix i. V.
questions.correctAnswer: General Power of Attorney with the prefix i. V.

questions.text: Florian Neuhaus receives a one-time task to buy one new mirror for a C&A fitting room. Which type of Commercial Power of Attorney is this?
options: Special Power of Attorney
General Power of Attorney
Category Power of Attorney
Sole Prokura

questions.text: When do internal restrictions on a Commercial Power of Attorney take legal effect against third parties?
options: Never, because internal limits cannot bind external parties
Only if they were published in the Commercial Register via EVI
If the third party knows or ought to know about the restriction
Only for contract amounts exceeding EUR 40,000.00
questions.correctAnswer: If the third party knows or ought to know about the restriction

questions.text: Under what condition may Fadil Berisha transfer his Commercial Power of Attorney to another person?
options: At any time without asking during vacation or illness
Only with the consent of the entrepreneur or a Prokurist
Never, because any transfer is strictly forbidden by law
As soon as the recipient is listed in the Commercial Register
questions.correctAnswer: Only with the consent of the entrepreneur or a Prokurist

questions.text: Just like Prokura, a Commercial Power of Attorney must be entered in the Commercial Register.
Both Category Power of Attorney and Special Power of Attorney are signed with the prefix i. A.
State four major differences between Prokura and a Commercial Power of Attorney.
questions.correctAnswer: 1. Who may grant it: Prokura only by Commercial Register companies; Commercial Power of Attorney by any entrepreneur or Prokurist. 2. Registration: Prokura requires Commercial Register entry plus EVI publication; Commercial Power of Attorney is not registered. 3. Scope: Prokura covers all business transactions including loans and court representation; Commercial Power of Attorney covers only ordinary transactions of that business, excluding loans and court. 4. Internal caps, signature, transfer: Internal limits on Prokura do not bind third parties (pp./ppa., non-transferable); on Commercial Power of Attorney they bind if known or ought to be known (i. V. or i. A., transferable with consent).
